results.title: Panama FIFA World Cup 2026 Preview: Los Canaleros look to improve on 2018 outing - Sportstar
highlights:
# Panama FIFA World Cup 2026 Preview: Los Canaleros look to improve on 2018 outing - Sportstar
[...]
In its World Cup debut in 2018, Panama was the worst-performing nation, with three defeats and having shipped 11 goals. In 2026, under a new head coach and with commendable results under its belt, there will be renewed hope of bettering that run, closer to home.
[...]
Panama had a 100% record in the second-round qualifiers and had a stuttering start in the next round with two draws. A 96th-minute equaliser from Ismael Diaz against Suriname last October enabled it to stay alive before two wins sealed Los Canaleros an automatic World Cup berth.
[...]
Ranked 33 now, Panama will head into the tournament as the highest-ranked Central American team. Christiansen has brought a structure and a definitive playing style, with midfielder Adalberto Carrasquilla at the heart of it.
[...]
Christiansen has banked on the experience with his squad selection with Panama’s squad boasting an average age of 31.1 – the oldest in the tournament, and an average of 53.4 caps per player – the second-highest behind Argentina.
[...]
The squad also has a good mix of goals spread across positions. Right wingback Amir Murillo provides an attacking verve from the flanks while Diaz and Jose Rodriguez will be able to stretch the pitch with their pace and directness.
[...]
##### Predicted XI (3-4-2-1)
[...]
Everything will come down to the opening game against Ghana if the work and progress under Christiansen in the last few years could materialise into meaningful results on the biggest stage.
[...]
Carrasquilla will be hard to miss on the field with his curly hair bobbing around the place, but his abilities on the ball will also make him an unmissable prospect. The attacking midfielder has the quality to unlock defences with his passing.
[...]
After brief coaching spells in Greece, England and Belgium, Christiansen took over the Panama role in 2019 and is now the nation’s longest-serving head coach. The Denmark-born Spanish head coach is heavily influenced by his time at Barcelona under Johan Cruyff. Christiansen is likely to employ a 3-4-2-1 shape, aiming to use possession and shape to stifle much-fancied sides.
[...]
FIFA Ranking: 33

- Defenders: Cesar Blackman, Jorge Gutierrez, Amir Murillo, ⁠Fidel Escobar, Andres Andrade, Edgardo Farina, Jose Cordoba, Eric Davis, Jiovany Ramos, Roderick Miller.
[...]
- Midfielders: Anibal Godoy, ‌Adalberto Carrasquilla, Carlos Harvey, Cristian Martinez, Jose Luis Rodriguez, Cesar Yanis, Yoel Barcenas, Alberto Quintero, Azarias Londono.
[...]

results.title: Panama at the 2026 World Cup: Los Canaleros Squad, Key Players & Group L Guide | Fanorate
highlights:
, captain Anibal Godoy, Carrasquilla
[...]
Panama are the clear outsiders in Group L, ranked well below England and Croatia. The expanded 48-team format, where the four best third-placed teams advance, offers a slim but real lifeline. Their realistic target is the match against Ghana on June 17 in Toronto — likely the game that defines whether they can compete for a knockout spot.
[...]
For Panama, simply being competitive and avoiding the winless, pointless return of 2018 would mark progress. A win — their first-ever at a World Cup — would be a historic achievement, and sneaking into the round of 32 would be a national triumph.
[...]
Under Thomas Christiansen, Panama are organised, disciplined and pragmatic. Expect a compact defensive block, deep lines against superior opponents, and a reliance on counter-attacks, set-pieces and the leadership of Godoy and Carrasquilla. Christiansen’s long tenure has instilled a clear identity and team cohesion that punches above the squad’s individual quality. The trade-off is limited creativity in sustained attack against deep blocks; Panama are at their best when defending a structure and breaking at speed.
[...]
Panama’s World Cup story is short but emotional. Their debut at Russia 2018 followed a famous qualifying campaign that ended in national celebration. The tournament itself was a brutal lesson at the elite level: a 3–0 loss to Belgium, a 6–1 defeat to England — brightened only by Felipe Baloy’s late goal, the nation’s first-ever at a World Cup — and a 2–1 loss to Tunisia. Panama finished bottom of their group and last in the tournament, conceding eleven goals across three games. The 2026 edition is their chance to write a far more competitive chapter, and to claim a maiden World Cup point or even a first win.
[...]
Panama open their 2026 campaign against Ghana in Toronto and close against England in New Jersey — a 2018 rematch.
